thread:
maria: Heads up — hitting a weird JSON-mode regression when auth retry kicks in. sampleapp parsing fails intermittently 
aj: hmm can you paste a tiny repro?
maria: repro below (very small):
```ts
// TS SDK
const res = await client.tool.call({ mode: 'json', input: userMsg })
console.log('raw ->', res.raw)
console.log('parsed ->', res.parsed)
// Sometimes `res.parsed` is a string that looks like an encoded JSON string, e.g. '"{\'k\':1}"' and parse fails in consumer
```
dan: I remember a similar one — auth/retry middleware reserializes the body while wrapping the request for a new token, so the SDK ends up double-encoding the JSON body on retry. Only shows up when mode=json because we stringify in one layer then expect parsed object back.
tyler: workaround: disable automatic retry for calls that set mode: 'json' or add a check in the retry path to avoid re-stringifying if content-type is application/json. quick patch we used locally: in retry layer do `if (typeof body === 'string' && body.startsWith('"')) body = JSON.parse(body)` before re-stringify. ugly but helps.
maria: confirmed tyler's workaround reduces the failures in my local sampleapp. still want a proper fix in SDK.
samantha: can you open an issue with a minimal repro and add e2e tests? tag eng-devex and mark P2?
maria: will open issue. adding logs:
```
[2026-03-10T17:02:12Z] request -> { mode: 'json', body: '{"prompt":"hi"}' }
[2026-03-10T17:02:13Z] retrying auth -> wrapping body
[2026-03-10T17:02:13Z] final body sent -> '"{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}"'
Error: Unexpected token '"' at position 0
```
aj: that log nails it. sounds like the auth refresh code does: body = JSON.stringify(body) without checking type.
dan: yeah, iterator: when we attach the auth wrapper we sometimes re-run serialize step. I'll take the fix — add guard in auth middleware to only stringify if body is an object, and add unit tests for string/Buffer paths. also add an integration test for json mode + auth refresh flows.
sdk-bot: created issue RW-2314: "json-mode: auth retry can double-encode body -> parsing errors" and assigned to @dan
maria: thanks — I'll add the minimal sampleapp repro to the issue (including the TS snippet and a tiny python runbook). will update once PR is up. :thumbsup:
